ALTER TABLE `IMC Competition Codex Global`
 ADD COLUMN world_type ENUM('SINGLE','MULTI') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SINGLE',
 ADD COLUMN competition_key_aliases JSON NULL,
 ADD COLUMN competition_group VARCHAR(32) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE UPPER(TRIM(sm_action_group)) WHEN 'DOMESTIC COMPETITION' THEN 'DOMESTIC' WHEN 'INTERNATIONAL COMPETITION' THEN 'INTERNATIONAL' WHEN 'NATIONAL TEAM COMPETITION' THEN 'NATIONS' ELSE UPPER(TRIM(sm_action_group)) END) VIRTUAL,
 ADD COLUMN IMC_View VARCHAR(255) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (custom_competition) VIRTUAL,
 ADD COLUMN nexus_view VARCHAR(255) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (custom_competition) VIRTUAL,
 ADD COLUMN updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
RENAME TABLE `IMC Competition Nexus Mapping` TO `IMC Competition Mapping Backup 20261116`

CREATE SQL SECURITY INVOKER VIEW `IMC Competition Nexus Mapping` AS
 SELECT c.id AS mapping_id,c.game_world_id,c.world_type,c.sm_country,c.competition_group,c.sm_action,CAST(c.sm_division AS CHAR(16)) AS sm_division,k.competition_key,c.IMC_View,c.updated_at,c.nexus_view
 FROM `IMC Competition Codex Global` c
 JOIN JSON_TABLE(JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE(JSON_ARRAY(c.competition_key),COALESCE(c.competition_key_aliases,JSON_ARRAY())), '$[*]' COLUMNS (competition_key VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')) AS k ON TRUE
